# `find_company`

**Find a company**

Search Companies House for a UK company by name, trading name or number. Start here whenever you have a name rather than a number, because every other tool in this server needs the number. Returns a shortlist with status, type and incorporation date so that companies with similar names can be told apart. When `disambiguation_needed` is true, ask the user which one they meant instead of taking the first result — dozens of live companies share a name, and picking the wrong one produces a confident answer about the wrong business.

This tool reads only and changes nothing, and calls an external service (the Companies House API).

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | Company name, partial name, or company number. |
| `items_per_page` | integer | no | How many records to return. Defaults to the API default; the maximum is 100. |
| `start_index` | integer | no | Zero-based offset into the full result set. Use pagination.has_more to decide. |
| `verbose` | boolean | no | Also return the untouched Companies House payload under `raw`, alongside the shaped result. Roughly two and a half times the size; use it only when a field you need is missing from the shaped result. |

## Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes | — |
| `companies` | object[] | yes | — |
| `companies[].company_number` | string | yes | Use this for every other tool in this server. |
| `companies[].name` | string | yes | — |
| `companies[].status` | string | no | active, dissolved, liquidation, administration, and so on. |
| `companies[].type` | string | no | Raw Companies House type slug, e.g. ltd. |
| `companies[].type_description` | string | no | The type in plain words. |
| `companies[].incorporated_on` | string | no | — |
| `companies[].dissolved_on` | string | no | — |
| `companies[].address` | string | no | Registered office, on one line. |
| `exact_name_match` | string | no | Company number whose name matches the query exactly. Absent if none did. |
| `disambiguation_needed` | boolean | yes | More than one candidate and no exact name match. Ask the user which one they meant. |
| `pagination` | object | yes | Where this page sits in the full result set. |
| `pagination.start_index` | number | yes | — |
| `pagination.items_per_page` | number | yes | — |
| `pagination.total_results` | number | yes | — |
| `pagination.returned` | number | yes | How many records are in this response. |
| `pagination.has_more` | boolean | yes | More records exist. Call again with start_index advanced by `returned`. |
| `meta` | object | yes | Provenance and budget for this answer. |
| `meta.cached` | boolean | yes | Answer came from the local cache rather than a live request. |
| `meta.stale` | boolean | yes | Answer came from an expired cache entry because Companies House was unreachable. Treat the data as possibly out of date. |
| `meta.age_seconds` | number | no | How long ago the cached answer was retrieved. Absent for a live answer. |
| `meta.rate_limit_remaining` | number | yes | Requests still available in the current five-minute window. Pace long runs by this. |
| `meta.rate_limit_resets_in_ms` | number | yes | Milliseconds until more budget becomes available. |
| `meta.licence` | `"OGL-v3.0"` | yes | OGL v3.0 applies to eligible public-sector information. Personal data and other OGL exclusions are not licensed by this label; applicable data-protection duties still apply. |
| `raw` | unknown | no | The untouched Companies House payload. Present only when verbose was true. |

On failure the tool returns `isError: true` and a payload carrying `code`,
`message`, `next_step` and `retryable` instead of the fields above. See
[the error reference](README.md#errors).
